name: firstmate
description: Claude Code mods for running firstmate.

plugins.name: wake-meter
plugins.description: Shows what firstmate's notifications cost in its primary session and nudges a restart when context grows.

plugins.name: crew-seatbelt
plugins.description: Refuses the shell actions that have cost firstmate workers their work or moved the captain's screen; active only in worker sessions.

plugins.name: guard-translator
plugins.description: Explains a firstmate guard refusal in plain words and offers the fixed command.

plugins.name: disk-sentinel
plugins.description: Status-line free-space alarm plus a /targets listing of build-cache dirs and whether a live task still owns them.
